1.consolidated_definition: Ataca a las caballerías cuando se les quita la silla o aparejo prontamente, a la luz de la luna, estando sofocadas o sudadas.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Attacks horses when their saddle or harness is removed promptly, under the light of the moon, especially if they are overheated or sweaty.
